note: old configuration produced multiplied retries (adapter retry x service retry x SDK retry); this round collapses them to a single owner per call path

owners.control_plane: worker/lease queue recovery (not a model transport retry)
owners.none: non-retryable by classification; no retry owner

rows.old_max_attempts: adapter retry 3 x service retry 3 x SDK retry (unbounded in practice) for non-streaming; streaming had service-level retry up to 3 plus QueryLoop 6
rows.new_budget_meaning: SDKModelClient issues exactly one actual HTTP request per QueryLoop attempt; QueryLoop keeps MODEL_STREAM_MAX_RETRIES=5 business attempts
rows.reason: multiplication removed; business recovery stays with the owner that knows transcript state

rows.scenario: Independent non-Harness model call (connection test, prompts, audit helpers)
rows.old_max_attempts: adapter retry 3 x service retry 3 (up to 9 actual requests)
rows.new_budget_meaning: initial attempt + 2 retries, 3 actual requests maximum, SDK num_retries=0
rows.reason: spec P05 asked for the SDK to own this budget; the SDK cannot bound its own retries observably, so the single client owns the same 3-request budget instead

rows.old_max_attempts: up to 3 on the adapter path before classification
old_multiplier_points: BaseLLMAdapter.retry retried any non-4xx error, including text-matched auth failures
rows.new_budget_meaning: auth and invalid-request errors are never retried

rows.scenario: Partial response already delivered, then failure
rows.old_max_attempts: streaming retry loop could restart after partial output only when no output was emitted; non-streaming adapter retry could replay a request that had produced content
old_multiplier_points: models/service.LLMService._execute_chat_completion_stream emitted-partial guard existed, but the non-streaming path had no such guard
rows.new_budget_meaning: the client never transparently replays after emitting token/tool events or receiving tool-call deltas; the failure surfaces as an error event with partial metadata
rows.reason: prevents splicing two responses into one success

rows.scenario: Worker/lease task recovery after crash or cancel
rows.new_budget_meaning: not a model transport retry: completed stages are reused; resumed workers do not re-issue model requests for finished perspectives

admission_control.note: rate limiting is an execution constraint and is not removed with models/retry.py
admission_control.mechanism: per provider+transport+endpoint+key semaphore and optional minimum gap, both still in LLMService
